# NorthBridge Digital & AI Solutions

NorthBridge Digital & AI Solutions is an international digital agency that delivers professional website design, e-commerce development, custom AI chatbot integration, graphic branding, B2B email marketing, and LinkedIn outreach services. Operating globally since 2024, our firm specializes in automation, high-converting pipelines, and 24/7 lead qualification.

## Core Information & Services

- [Homepage](https://northbridgedatasolutions.com/): Our primary landing page presenting services, case metrics, team members, and contact forms.
- [Chatbots & AI Support](https://northbridgedatasolutions.com/#services): Custom AI chatbots for 24/7 client support and automatic inbound lead qualification on websites, WhatsApp, and messaging apps.
- [Website & Webstore Development](https://northbridgedatasolutions.com/#services): Highly responsive, SEO-ready custom websites and e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce) delivered in 3 to 7 days.
- [B2B LinkedIn & Email Outreach](https://northbridgedatasolutions.com/#services): Profile optimization, Sales Navigator targeting, and outbound campaigns to schedule qualified meetings.
- [Graphics Designing & Branding](https://northbridgedatasolutions.com/#services): Creative visual brand assets, logos, social media graphics, and UI/UX assets.
- [Social Accounts & Email Marketing](https://northbridgedatasolutions.com/#services): End-to-end multi-platform social management and deliverability-optimized email drip sequences.
